parameters.query: SELECT id, name, url, source_type, last_checked, consecutive_failures, is_active FROM content_sources WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY last_checked ASC NULLS FIRST

UPDATE content_sources SET last_checked = '{{ $json.checked_at }}', is_healthy = {{ $json.is_healthy }}, last_status_code = {{ $json.status_code || 'NULL' }}, last_response_time_ms = {{ $json.response_time_ms || 'NULL' }}, consecutive_failures = {{ $json.consecutive_failures }}, last_error = {{ $json.error_message ? `'${$json.error_message.replace(/'/g, "''")}' ` : 'NULL' }} WHERE id = {{ $json.source_id }}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_sources, SUM(CASE WHEN is_healthy THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as healthy_sources, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_healthy THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unhealthy_sources, ROUND(AVG(last_response_time_ms)) as avg_response_time_ms FROM content_sources WHERE is_active = true
